warnings.message: HWP alpha editing requires the same UTF-16 code-unit length per text run. Length-changing and structural edits are blocked to retain character/line offsets.
HWP is shown as structured text, not a page-faithful rendering. Table/control/style streams are retained but not visually reconstructed.
Stored preview content remains unchanged and may be stale after editing.
The workspace preview is approximate. Hancom layout, pagination and font fidelity have not been certified.
